sv.title: Turkisk polisräd mot oppositionell tv-kanal
sv.summary: Turkisk polis slog på tisdagen till mot det oberoende mediehuset Sözcü och har gripit flera chefer. Oppositionsledaren Özgür Özel skriver att ”vi låter oss inte tystas”.

en.title: Turkish police raid opposition TV channel
en.summary: Turkish police on Tuesday raided the independent media group Sözcü and have detained several of its executives. Opposition leader Özgür Özel writes that "we will not let ourselves be silenced".
